items.name: Åkerveronika
items.observations: Educational original watercolor of Veronica arvensis, a small annual speedwell with fine hairy ascending stems, opposed broad bluntly-toothed lower leaves, smaller sessile upper bracts, congested terminal racemes of tiny violet-blue four-lobed flowers and notched developing capsules. Compared with field morphology; inspected against a black background.
items.limitations: Stylized drawing, not a voucher specimen or photographic proof. Flowers enlarged relative to true 2–4mm size for readability; not suitable as a standalone identification key.
